name: k-kinzal/lemon-parser
description: Parser for Lemon grammar files, producing a lossless syntax tree

scripts-descriptions.autoload:check: Check that the PSR-4 autoload mapping is strict and unambiguous.
scripts-descriptions.bench:quick: Run the benchmarks with fewer iterations.
scripts-descriptions.compat: Check compatibility with PHP 8.1 and later with PHP_CodeSniffer.
scripts-descriptions.deptrac: Check the layer dependencies with Deptrac.
scripts-descriptions.docgen: Generate the API documentation into build/docs.
scripts-descriptions.docgen:diff: Generate the API documentation marked with the changes against origin/main, and serve it.
scripts-descriptions.docgen:fresh: Generate the API documentation without the cache.
scripts-descriptions.docgen:serve: Generate the API documentation and serve it locally.
scripts-descriptions.doctest: Run the @example blocks of the PHPDoc as tests.
scripts-descriptions.format: Fix the code style with PHP-CS-Fixer.
scripts-descriptions.format:check: Check the code style with PHP-CS-Fixer without changing files.
scripts-descriptions.lint: Run every static check: autoload, formatting, PHPStan, PHP compatibility, size and tree guards, and layer dependencies.
scripts-descriptions.spec: Run the Behat specification of the Lemon grammar-file language against the parser.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run all test suites in parallel.
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: Run the unit tests in parallel and write the coverage and JUnit reports to build/.
